_about: Order of chapters in the final PDF. Export each Google Doc (File → Download → PDF) into content/source/parts/ using the 'file' name, then run: cd bridge-course && npm run product:inspect -- --merge. Doc titles are from the Drive folder 'bridge course notes by Rakesh pandey' (inspected 2026-09-25). Paper numbers marked '?' are not printed in the notes themselves; the others are.
notes: Pedagogy of Language-II has TWO docs titled 'Unit 11 - Other Dimensions of Assessment'. Use the one last modified 25 Sep 2026 17:32; the other was never edited after creation. Confirm and delete the duplicate in Drive.
Pedagogy of The World Around Us has no Unit 3 or Unit 4 docs in the folder. Confirm whether they are intentionally omitted before selling.
Curriculum, Pedagogy and Assessment has only Unit 1. Confirm this is complete.
